response.sql: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS transaction_total FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT state, transaction_total, transaction_total / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_total) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_totals), share_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.transaction_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM state_shares AS s CROSS JOIN share_average AS a WHERE s.share > a.average_share
